headline: A 2012 executive order brought back a federal advisory group that gives advice to the government.
what_it_does: This order reestablishes an advisory group, meaning a panel that offers advice to the federal government. The title does not say which group it is, what topic it covers, or who serves on it. No summary was provided, so other details are unclear.

who_it_affects.how: They are able to meet and give advice to the government again under this order.

when_it_takes_effect: No date is stated in the material provided. The order was signed December 7, 2012.
